definition: The numerical solvers that turn a trained diffusion model into images in tens of steps instead of a thousand, deterministic (ODE-based, like DDIM) or stochastic (SDE-based).
details: The numerical solvers that turn a trained diffusion model into images in tens of steps instead of a thousand, deterministic (ODE-based, like DDIM) or stochastic (SDE-based). The user-facing dial between generation speed and fidelity.

explainer.lead: Samplers are the numerical solvers that turn a trained diffusion model into images in tens of steps instead of a thousand. They are the user-facing dial between generation speed and fidelity.

tiers.eli5: Like a shortcut recipe that gets you a finished cake in a few minutes instead of baking it the long way.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers choose deterministic ODE-based samplers like DDIM or stochastic SDE-based ones depending on the speed-fidelity tradeoff they need. The pitfall is expecting high step counts' fidelity from very few steps.
tiers.paperLevel: Solvers integrate the diffusion process over far fewer steps than a thousand, either deterministic (ODE-based, e.g. DDIM) or stochastic (SDE-based). Limits: speed comes at some cost to fidelity.

explainer.example: Generating an image with DDIM in tens of steps rather than a thousand gives a fast approximation of the slower sampling result.
